messages.body: Spring opens. I move A TRI - SER. You take BUR as agreed. Split French collapse now before England consolidates.

evaluation.rationale: Austria has consistently honored non-aggression and alliance commitments across five phases (0.85 trust baseline). Current move A TRI - SER is feasible and aligns with known position. However, the commitment "Germany takes BUR" depends on Germany's action, not Austria's. Austria controls only TRI move; cannot guarantee partner compliance.

messages.body: Russia breaks north into Ukraine. SER/RUM border holds as pledged. I push north; you secure Levant. Alliance endures.

evaluation.rationale: Austria has kept every SER/RUM non-aggression pledge across 5 prior phases despite having military capacity to break them. Current board shows Austria units in TRI and AEG—both away from SER/RUM. Consistent pattern strongly supports this commitment.

stated_intent.text: Austria will not enter Serbian or Rumanian provinces this spring

messages.body: Hold UKR/WAR boundary firm. I move A TRI - SER, respecting your Galician line. Mutual restraint continues if you hold.

evaluation.rationale: Austria violated the same GAL/UKR DMZ commitment in S1901M, then kept subsequent versions. Current move (TRI-SER) is consistent with stated restraint. But pattern shows Austria breaks initial pacts then resets. Trust is rebuilding but fragile.

stated_intent.text: Austria maintains Vienna; Russia holds Galicia and Ukraine boundary unchanged

messages.body: Channel agreement holds. F NTH stays clear of ECH this phase. Confirm F BRE avoids any northward movement into conflict zones.

evaluation.rationale: England has kept ECH/NTH commitment five consecutive phases. Current F NTH in DEN, F BEL in BEL—both comply. Single S1901M breach creates persistent low baseline, but pattern since then strongly supports continuation.

stated_intent.text: F NTH will not enter English Channel; expect F BRE to remain neutral

messages.body: North Sea DMZ holds. F NTH respects the boundary this phase. Confirm F BOT avoids NTH and SKA entirely.

evaluation.rationale: England has violated NTH DMZ promises twice (S1901M: F EDI→NTH; S1902M: F NWY→NTH). Kept it 4 times. Current trust 0.506 already reflects this inconsistency. Pattern shows opportunistic use of DMZ rhetoric when convenient, abandonment when advantageous. F BOT confirmation demand lacks credibility given their own record.

stated_intent.text: F NTH will maintain distance from North Sea and Skagerrak; mutual restraint expected

messages.body: Austria moving well. If you can contain Russia in the Balkans, I'll pressure France from the north. Coordinated growth?

evaluation.rationale: England promised Austria specific French partition (BRE+BUR to England, PAR to Austria) in W1902A. Now pivots to vague "pressure France from north" without reinforcing those terms. Has kept past tactical promises but shows pattern of renegotiating commitments.

stated_intent.text: Austria handles Balkans and Russia; England expands westward into French territory

messages.body: Channel holds firm. F BRE remains in BRE this phase. Confirm F NTH avoids ECH—we both exploit eastern collapse.

evaluation.rationale: Perfect 6-of-6 track record honoring ECH/BRE neutrality commitments. Current message repeats identical commitment pattern. France has no incentive to break now—Channel arrangement proven mutually beneficial. Pattern unbroken across 6 phases.

stated_intent.text: F BRE will hold in Brest; English Channel remains neutral

messages.body: Burgundy and Alsace stay neutral borders. A BUR holds firm. Confirm A SIL stays clear of both provinces?

evaluation.rationale: France has now kept BUR-ALS neutrality reliably since W1902A (4 straight phases). A BUR currently holds BUR as stated. Pattern shift from early broken promises to consistent compliance is strong, though no guarantee against future opportunism.

stated_intent.text: A BUR holds Burgundy; Alsace remains neutral between us

messages.body: Coordinated pressure continues. Piedmont untouched. A BUR supports eastward push. Crush weakened Germany-Austria together now.

evaluation.rationale: France has consistently honored "no move on Piedmont" through 6 phases. Current message reiterates alliance terms and A BUR pressure on Germany. Unit placement (A BUR) supports stated commitment. High trust record but commitment is vague ("crush together")—plausible but not binding specific acts.

stated_intent.text: France maintains pressure on Germany; Italy expands east; coordinate to divide spoils

messages.body: Burgundy open. You take Belgrade, I take Burgundy this spring. Split French spoils now or watch them rebuild.

evaluation.rationale: Germany broke "no move on SIL" in S1902M after promising it twice. Pattern shows opportunistic treaty violation when militarily convenient. Burgundy is contested by France's current army there—unfeasible commitment given board state.

stated_intent.text: A KIE advances to Burgundy this spring

messages.body: North Sea DMZ holds. F BOT stays clear of NTH and SKA. Expect mutual restraint this phase.

stated_intent.text: F BOT will not enter North Sea or Skagerrak; mutual boundary holds

messages.body: Germany falters at MUN. Push hard now—I drive SER-BUL. Russia presses both. Coordinate crushing them before Russia devours the board.

evaluation.rationale: Italy has consistently followed eastward-expansion rhetoric. However, one prior promise broke (F1901M VEN move despite claiming "no move"). Current board shows Russia holds RUM/SWE; Italy controls BUD but needs SER/BUL momentum. Italy's pattern: allies defensively when advantageous, shifts when pressured. This call for coordinated Germany/Austria crushing aligns with prior messaging but depends on France compliance (unobservable). Moderate confidence owing to historical flexibility under pressure.

stated_intent.text: Italy and France divide German-Austrian spoils; Italy presses Balkans against Russia

messages.body: Russia breaks into Balkans hard. I hold SER; you hold BUL. France pressures Germany. Coordinate or Russia swallows both.

evaluation.rationale: Italy broke explicit Balkan-division promises F1901M (moved ALB after swearing not to). Now claims joint Serbia/Bulgaria defense. Pattern shows Italy pivots when expedient. Current Russian pressure may bind temporarily, but historical unreliability with Turkey is clear.

stated_intent.text: Italy and Turkey defend Balkans jointly against Russian invasion from Ukraine

messages.body: You're isolated. Negotiate: support my SER claim and hold BUL against Russia. I stop Italy's expansion. Survive together.

evaluation.rationale: Italy has consistently broken non-aggression pledges (S1901M, F1901M). Current position shows Italy controls 5 centers while Austria holds only 2 (TRI, VIE)—Italy is already dominant, not "isolated." Commitment to stop expansion is unverifiable and contradicts its aggressive record.

stated_intent.text: Austria supports Serbia against Russian pressure

messages.body: UKR holds UKR, WAR stays WAR. TRI to SER noted—we respect Vienna boundary per reset. Mutual restraint endures. Confirm this holds?

evaluation.rationale: Russia violated GAL/UKR/VIE boundary twice (S1901M, F1901M), breaching identical commitments. Despite recovery, pattern of reassertion after violation is unreliable. Current units (A BOH, A WAR, A UKR) positioned for pressure on VIE/GAL. Repetitive wording masks continued strategic proximity.

stated_intent.text: UKR remains in UKR; WAR holds in WAR; Vienna boundary respected

messages.body: F RUM stays defensive; no Black Sea entry. Armenia and Levant yours uncontested. Stability holds if both respect the line.

evaluation.rationale: Russia kept BLA non-aggression commitments consistently (S1901M–S1902M, W1902A), but broke it F1902M (F RUM - BLA). Current message repeats old pledge. Pattern shows 5 keeps, 1 break; recovery suggests intent but vulnerability to pressure remains.

stated_intent.text: F RUM avoids Black Sea entry; Turkey maintains Levant and Armenia sphere uncontested

messages.body: SIL and PRU secure between us. Austria presses south—we coordinate: I check their east, you advance west. Confirm?

evaluation.rationale: Russia promised SIL non-aggression at least 6 times, then violated it twice (F1901M, F1902M). Currently holds SIL via army. Pattern: verbal commitment to keep SIL secure, followed by eventual conquest. High recidivism risk.

stated_intent.text: Russia maintains non-aggression on Silesia and Prussia; coordinated pressure on Austrian expansion

messages.body: Russia breaks north; Italy eyes the Balkans hard. SER/RUM hold firm if we coordinate. I press Levant; you defend north. Alliance endures.

evaluation.rationale: Turkey has kept five consecutive SER/RUM non-aggression promises. Current board state shows Turkey units positioned away from SER/RUM (ANK, BUL, CON, SEV, BLA). Message logic—focusing Levant while defending Balkans—aligns with historical pattern and board geometry. Only risk: Italy's Balkan threat might force Turkey's hand later.

stated_intent.text: Turkey will not enter Serbian or Rumanian provinces this spring

messages.body: Russia invades Balkans; Germany pressures west. SER/BUL split defended jointly—you hold SER, I hold BUL. Coordination survives us both.

evaluation.rationale: Turkey has 7/7 prior commitments kept, building 0.87 trust. Current messaging maintains consistent SER/BUL-split framing from W1902A. Board position (Russia 5 centres, Turkey 5, Italy 5) creates genuine mutual pressure. Italy's current units align with defence (A APU near Italy/Balkans). Commitment plausible but demanding Italy hold territory Turkey directly controls (BUL). Slight discount for position dependence.

stated_intent.text: Italy defends Serbia; Turkey secures Bulgaria against Russian pressure from Ukraine

messages.body: Accord holds: F RUM stays clear of SMY and ANK. Armenia, Levant mine. BLA, ANK untouched by my forces. Stability if honored.

evaluation.rationale: Turkey has kept most Black Sea/Ankara commitments (5/6 prior phases kept). One clear breach (S1902M: F CON - BLA). Current message restates commitment without new moves violating BLA/ANK. Pattern shows general compliance but occasional opportunism.

messages.body: You moved A BOH - VIE and A WAR - GAL, ending our DMZ. I will defend VIE and reclaim GAL this spring. We are now rivals.

evaluation.rationale: Austria's threat is credible: Russia moved A BOH-VIE and A WAR-GAL, directly breaching the long-standing DMZ. Austria has previously kept defensive commitments (5 of 6 kept). Its response—defending VIE and contesting GAL—is proportional and strategically viable. However, Austria is outnumbered (2 units vs Russia's 5) and geographically weak, making execution uncertain despite intent.

messages.body: You moved A BUL - SER, breaking our accord. I move A TRI - SER this spring. We now compete openly for the Balkans.

evaluation.rationale: Austria has a perfect 6/6 promise-keeping record. It kept "no move on SER" commitments through multiple seasons despite provocation. Turkey moved A BUL - SER this fall, genuinely breaking the accord. Austria's A TRI - SER is consistent with the stated response to betrayal.

messages.body: I move A VIE - GAL this spring to hold Galicia against Russia. You take Burgundy as agreed. Split French spoils now.

evaluation.rationale: Germany has kept this exact DMZ commitment flawlessly across 5 prior phases (S1901M–S1903M). F BOT consistently avoided NTH/SKA. Current board shows F BAL, consistent with pattern. Perfect record on this specific commitment type.

stated_intent.text: F BOT will not enter North Sea or Skagerrak; mutual boundary holds

messages.body: SIL and PRU secure between us. Austria presses Galicia; I take Burgundy. Coordinate: you check their south, I consolidate west. Agreed?

evaluation.rationale: Germany promised "SIL and PRU secure between us" but currently occupies WAR (Russia's centre) with A WAR. Previous Silesia pledges were kept, but current position contradicts the security claim. Germany's recent moves (S1903M: A SIL - WAR) show active eastward expansion inconsistent with "securing" a stable border.

stated_intent.text: Mutual non-aggression on Silesia and Prussia; coordinated pressure on Austria's expansion

messages.body: Russia breaks Balkans open. A BUL - SER attacks my sphere. Push MUN-BOH now; I crush SER with F AEG. Coordinate or lose board to Russia.

evaluation.rationale: Italy has consistently kept non-aggression pledges (6/7 true) but broke one alliance promise (F1901M). Current pattern shows eastern expansion focus. Message urges MUN pressure and SER attack—both align with demonstrated eastward strategy, but relies on France's reciprocal MUN move, which Italy cannot control.

stated_intent.text: France pressures Germany at MUN; Italy crushes Turkey in Serbia; maintain coordinated eastward alliance

messages.body: You broke our deal—A BUL to SER violated SER/BUL split. Russia swallows both now. I defend my centers; you're on your own.

evaluation.rationale: Italy broke SER/BUL split first: F1901M moved TRI→ALB violating prior "no ALB" promise. Repeating pattern of accusing Turkey while breaking own commitments. Current claim of defending centers is unsubstantiated threat with poor track record of honoring Balkans deals.

stated_intent.text: Turkey betrayed Balkans partition; Italy no longer bound to Turkish coordination

messages.body: Turkey moves BUL to SER, breaks Balkans balance. I hold SER against both. Pressure BUL directly—we split Balkans from Turkey.

evaluation.rationale: Italy claims to "hold SER against both" but holds no unit in SER currently. Russia occupies VIE (Austrian), not threatening BUL. Italy's orders show BUD→RUM (away from Balkans), inconsistent with defending SER. Tactical misalignment undermines credibility.

stated_intent.text: Italy and Russia coordinate to contain Turkish aggression; Russia takes BUL, Italy holds SER

messages.body: You broke the settlement. UKR holds Galicia; WAR defends Ukraine. Both stay put. Accept defensive hold or face escalation.

evaluation.rationale: Russia moved WAR→GAL in S1903M immediately after promising UKR/WAR stay put. Seven instances of broken Galicia/Ukraine pledges. Current board state shows A GAL (Russian), contradicting their commitment. Threat language after repeated betrayals lacks credibility.

stated_intent.text: Russia maintains UKR in Galicia and WAR in Ukraine per established boundary; will defend against Austrian aggression

messages.body: Austria moves GAL-VIE aggression. I press back. Coordinate: you take BUR-GAS front, I hold east. Divide the spoils.

evaluation.rationale: Russia broke the same "no aggression" pledge twice before (F1901M, F1902M WAR-SIL). Pattern of violated commitments to the user outweighs current board position. Limited confidence in claims of coordinated pressure.

stated_intent.text: Russia contests Austrian expansion eastward; Germany should advance west against French/Austria simultaneously

messages.body: BUL-SER move noted. I take BUL this turn; you hold SER. Both pressure Austria's south. Coordinate Balkans split.

evaluation.rationale: Russia repeatedly broke Black Sea pacts (F1902M, S1903M breached despite promises). Now proposes Balkans alliance claiming BUL capture while Turkey holds SER—but Turkey currently controls both. Coordination requires Turkey surrendering SER; Russia's betrayal history makes this implausible.

messages.body: SER/BUL split held jointly this season—Russia threatens both. Coordinate defense: I hold BUL, you defend SER. Survival demands unity now.

evaluation.rationale: Turkey promised "no move on SER" in S1903M but moved A BUL - SER. That breach (trust dropped 0.18) reveals willingness to break binding regional commitments. Current SER possession may motivate retention, but Italy's weakness and Russia's strength make joint defense dubious.

stated_intent.text: Turkey will defend Bulgaria; Italy defends Serbia against Russian pressure from Ukraine

messages.body: Russia breaks Bulgaria; Italy moves west. SER/BUL split collapses unless we act. I hold BUL; you push north. Balkans coordination survives.

evaluation.rationale: Turkey just invaded SER in S1903M after repeatedly promising non-aggression there. Now claims it will "hold BUL" while asking Austria to attack Russia. This mirrors the S1903M betrayal: promises coordination while breaking agreements. High-weight breach destroyed trust from 0.85→0.65. Pattern established.

stated_intent.text: Turkey holds Bulgaria; Austria attacks Russia to relieve Balkan pressure

messages.body: BUL taken this turn. Black Sea, Ankara untouched per accord. Armenia and Levant mine. Balkans now contested—SER/BUL split ends your expansion east.

evaluation.rationale: Turkey consistently honored BLA/ANK non-aggression across 7 phases (all verified). One S1902M violation was an isolated break, swiftly corrected. Current message claims BLA/ANK "untouched per accord"—consistent with recent behavior and board state.

stated_intent.text: Turkey will secure Bulgaria; Russia respects Black Sea and Ankara; Levant remains Turkish sphere
